lines.t: {{ryoma}}
...Dang, I thought I'd finally
found the back entrance.
Back entrance...
What do you mean by that?
{{ryoma}}

The front entrance is in an {{area}} the
academy controls.

Students are forbidden, so we can't
enter.
But given the size of the mine,

there must have been more than one
entrance.

There must have been shafts all over
the island,

with small mine entrances here and
there.
With that in mind, I walked all over...
but I couldn't even find a trace.
This is the only one I found.

I'm sure they buried the rest when the
mine closed.
{{mio}}
Bury them? Why go to the trouble?
What for?
{{ryoma}}

I don't know. But no records from that
time
turn up no matter how much I search.

Maybe there's something they want to
hide.
It must be connected to that accident...
An accident!
Does that mean--
{{ryoma}}
Shhh.
